domains.label: Application shell
domains.description: Initialisation, routing, shared application state, deployment configuration and Flow type declarations that support the customer self-service frontend.

items.summary: Contains the application entry, router, shared state store, configuration, types, utilities and project/deployment setup.

items.name: flow-typed/npm
items.summary: Provides Flow declaration stubs for the npm packages used by the frontend.

items.name: src
items.summary: Holds the frontend application shell and shared modules, including routes, state, configuration, types and utilities.

domains.label: Backend API
domains.description: Client API modules wrap requests to the customer, policy and self-service backends.

items.name: src/api
items.summary: Groups the API clients and shared request helpers for customer, policy and self-service operations.

domains.label: Shared components
domains.description: Reusable UI components provide navigation, access control, site framing and chat presentation.

items.name: src/components
items.summary: Contains shared interface components used across pages.

items.name: src/components/ChatRoom
items.summary: Renders the conversation message list and message-entry form, grouping messages by time.

domains.label: Registration
domains.description: Registration screens collect customer profile details required to complete account signup.

items.name: src/pages/CompleteRegistration
items.summary: Provides the post-signup customer profile completion flow.

domains.label: Customer contact
domains.description: Contact pages let a signed-in customer review interactions and converse with customer service.

items.name: src/pages/Contact
items.summary: Displays the customer contact/chat interface and interaction history.

domains.label: Policies and quotes
domains.description: Policy pages display existing insurance policies and let customers request and respond to insurance quotes.

items.name: src/pages/MyPolicies
items.summary: Shows the customer’s policies and insurance quote request overview and details.

items.name: src/pages/MyPolicies/RequestInsuranceQuote
items.summary: Guides a customer through a multi-step insurance quote request, including contact and billing addresses.

domains.label: Customer profile
domains.description: Profile screens display customer details and support updating the registered address.

items.name: src/pages/MyProfile
items.summary: Displays the customer profile and provides an address-change form.

domains.label: Other pages
domains.description: Remaining application pages do not fall within the listed functional page areas.

items.name: src/pages
items.summary: Contains the frontend page modules, including home, login, signup and the feature-specific page groups.
